collection.description: A villager watches a miniature fleet drift toward the shore.

e1.name: Ending 1
e1.text: (Name1) watches a miniature fleet drift toward the shore. Nobody wants the game to end, even when supper is called.

e3.name: Ending 3
e3.text: (Name1) watches a miniature fleet drift toward the shore. (Name1) had expected to win and is surprised not to mind losing.

e4.name: Ending 4
e4.text: (Name1) watches a miniature fleet drift toward the shore. A passing breeze changes everyone's predictions.

e2__fx.name: Ending 2
e2__fx.text: (Name1) watches a miniature fleet drift toward the shore. One boat spins in circles, to the delight of its maker.
